long_biography.plain_text:
Midland co-founder Alex Shnaider stocked shelves and cleaned floors in his parents' Toronto delicatessen as a teenager. Working with customers taught him to deal with different people, while his parents' seven-day working week made business an everyday discipline. He went on to study economics at York University.

His enthusiasm for motor racing became a team investment when he bought Jordan Grand Prix in 2005. Purchasing an established entrant gave him immediate access to television revenues, avoiding the waiting period faced by a new team. He wanted Formula One to introduce Midland to a wider business audience. The team raced under the Midland name before he sold it to Spyker in 2006.
